start: Member: Settings, Your data, not signed in, joined a gym, Health Connect used

user_sees: Question 'Erase all data?' saying in one line what goes, that Health Connect copies stay and that the gym is told
Button 'Erase everything'
must_not: Erasing before the question
The question leaving out the gym

user_sees: 'Erasing…' then the welcome screen
must_not: Demo data loaded again
Old workouts still on Home after re-onboarding

start: Member: Settings, Your data, signed in to a MettleUp account, online

user_sees: 'What do you want to erase?' with 'Erase this phone only', 'Erase this phone and delete my MettleUp account' and 'Cancel'
must_not: A single erase question that hides the account

steps.action: Tap 'Erase this phone and delete my MettleUp account', then 'Erase and delete'
user_sees: 'Erase this phone and delete your account?'
Then the welcome screen
must_not: The phone erased while the account stays
Signing in again brings the deleted workouts back

start: Member: Settings, Your data, signed in, offline

steps.action: Tap 'Erase all data', then 'Erase this phone and delete my MettleUp account', 'Erase and delete'
user_sees: Red 'Could not delete your MettleUp account, so nothing was erased. Check your internet and try again.'
must_not: An empty phone with a full account

user_sees: The card as before
must_not: Anything deleted

start: Member: Settings, Your data, demo data loaded plus 2 workouts the member logged

user_sees: 'Removing…' then the Workout tab
must_not: The member's own 2 workouts deleted
The 'Demo data loaded' badge still shown

user_sees: Only 'Erase all data' and its line
must_not: 'Remove demo data' still offered

start: Member: Settings, Your data, Google Drive was used, joined a gym

steps.action: Tap 'Erase all data' and read the question
user_sees: 'Your backup file in Google Drive stays. Delete it in Google Drive if you want it gone.'
The gym the member leaves
must_not: The Drive file claimed as deleted
The gym still holding the member as joined after the next time online
